protocol.reference: same frozen Sol reviews; not ground truth
protocol.comparison: raw Clef-27B and Flash on all 6600; raw and calibrated scores on the identical 3300-record heldout half
protocol.split: 50/50 within each dataset/source; deterministic source-specific SHA256 seed 20261028; no probability or label-based split selection
protocol.calibrator: one pooled four-class L2-regularized multinomial logistic regression on clipped log probabilities; C=1.0; max_iter=2000; no class weights or source/dataset features
protocol.gate: fit on calibration half only; use 5-fold stratified CV, shuffled seed 20261028; adopt calibration only if out-of-fold multiclass log loss improves by at least 1% relative to raw scores
protocol.evaluation: heldout labels never used for fitting, gate, prompt or hyperparameter selection; paired within-source bootstrap with 1000 replicates for MCC/macro-F1/accuracy/log-loss differences
protocol.flash_control: apply exactly the same split, calibrator and gate to existing Flash scores without new inference
protocol.context: full inputs; independently compare reference encoder tokens with native vLLM encoding; no truncation
protocol.limitations: the heldout half is held out from calibration fitting, not a newly collected benchmark; original Flash aggregate outcomes have already been examined

flash.method: multinomial logistic regression on clipped log probabilities, L2 C=1.0
flash.gate: at least 1% relative out-of-fold log-loss improvement

clef.method: multinomial logistic regression on clipped log probabilities, L2 C=1.0
clef.gate: at least 1% relative out-of-fold log-loss improvement

flash.policy: Preserve the API choice for raw decisions, including exact probability ties; calibrated decisions use argmax.

clef.policy: Preserve the API choice for raw decisions, including exact probability ties; calibrated decisions use argmax.
